import json
import unittest


class JSONUTF8RoundTripTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_chinese_json_utf8_roundtrip(self):
        payload = {
            "name": "验收中文",
            "message": "MySQL JSON 中文字段 UTF-8 往返",
            "tags": ["中文", "验收"],
        }

        serialized = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
        self.assertIn("验收中文", serialized)

        encoded = serialized.encode("utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(encoded, serialized.encode("utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual("验收中文".encode("utf-8"), b"\xe9\xaa\x8c\xe6\x94\xb6\xe4\xb8\xad\xe6\x96\x87")
        self.assertIn("验收中文".encode("utf-8"), encoded)

        decoded = encoded.decode("utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(decoded, serialized)

        restored = json.loads(decoded)
        self.assertEqual(restored, payload)
        self.assertEqual(restored["name"].encode("utf-8"), "验收中文".encode("utf-8"))

        print("MYSQL149_WORKER_OK", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
